text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to do tasks that normally need human intelligence, such as learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. Machine learning is a part of AI where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses large neural networks to find patterns in huge amounts of information. Today, AI is everywhere in daily life. It helps suggest films on streaming sites, translates languages, recognises faces on phones, and powers voice assistants. Doctors also use it to study medical images, and banks use it to catch fraud.
